verdict.rationale: Lovable supports exporting/syncing code to GitHub/GitLab or downloading the codebase, explicitly stating this lets you 'deploy outside Lovable' and work locally in your own IDE/workflow. However, Lovable's own hosting/publish flow is the primary deployment path, and there's no dedicated one-click deploy to external hosts (e.g., Vercel/AWS) beyond code export, making external deployment a manual, developer-driven process.
